course_name_original: Elasticidad y Resistencia de Materiales I (12707)
course_name_en: Elasticity and Strength of Materials I
prerequisites: Proficiency in the principles of Physics I / Mechanics (statics of rigid body, equilibrium of forces and moments, free body diagrams)
Proficiency in Mass Geometry (calculation of centers of gravity, moments of inertia and product of inertia)
Proficiency in Calculus / Algebra (integration, derivation, resolution of simple differential equations and matrix algebra)

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of the fundamentals of science, technology and chemistry.
Understand the relationship between microstructure, synthesis or processing, and material properties.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge and use of the principles of material strength.

syllabus_topics: Variation of volume, area and length
teaching_methods: Participatory classes, case studies, technical application exercises, oral and written presentations, debates
Group work (preparation of essays, problem solving, projects for submission and presentation in practical classes)
Individual study (preparation of readings, exams, exercises, class preparation)
assessment_rules: For averaging with tasks, Integrated Project, and observation, written tests must be passed with a grade higher than 4. The course will be considered passed if the final grade is equal to or greater than 5 points and no written part grade is less than 4 points. In the first sitting, failed parts can be retaken. If the grade in written tests is below 4, the course will be failed, and the final grade will be 'Not Presented' (if absent from the exam) or the grade obtained. In the second sitting, Integrated Project grades will be maintained.
